title: Naturalness and self-so
shortSummary: In early Daoist texts, ziran first concerns being so of itself and should not be equated directly with the modern category of nature.
curatorialDescription: The concept layer separates passages, commentaries and modern interpretations so that one translation does not erase historical meanings.
researchNote: Variants of the Daodejing and Tang commentaries on ziran still need to be added.
